component.name: APRS & Packet
component.summary: APRS station and packet radio terminal for a KISS TNC
APRS stanice a packet radio terminál pro KISS TNC

description.p: Turns a radio with a KISS TNC into an APRS station and a packet radio terminal. Made for the Quansheng UV-K1/UV-K5 V3 with the F4HWN firmware, but any KISS TNC works: Direwolf, a hardware TNC, or a radio on a USB serial port or on the network.

ul.li: Map of the stations heard, with their APRS symbols
APRS messages as conversations, retried until acknowledged
Stations heard on the radio or on APRS-IS, with distance and direction
Packet terminal for BBSes and nodes (AX.25 connected mode)
Packet chat and a TNC-style frame monitor

description.p: Transmitting is off until you switch it on; it is for licensed radio amateurs only.

Z rádia s KISS TNC udělá APRS stanici a packet radio terminál. Dělané pro Quansheng UV-K1/UV-K5 V3 s firmwarem F4HWN, funguje ale s jakýmkoli KISS TNC: Direwolf, hardwarové TNC, nebo rádio na USB sériovém portu či v síti.

ul.li: Mapa slyšených stanic s jejich APRS symboly
APRS zprávy jako konverzace, opakované do potvrzení
Stanice slyšené rádiem nebo přes APRS-IS se vzdáleností a směrem
Packet terminál pro BBS a nody (AX.25 spojení)
Packet chat a monitor rámců jako na TNC

description.p: Vysílání je vypnuté, dokud ho nezapneš; je jen pro radioamatéry s licencí.

description.p: Kilometres or miles, °C or °F, hPa or inHg (as the system, or chosen); the temperature around you on the map from the weather stations within 20 km; the map filter with how far (internet and radio) and a count of stations on the map; what is new after an update; the tracker offer at most once an hour with Not today; lists open on their last line at once; Messages All / Unread count conversations; framed bars at the bottom; the handheld radio icon wherever the radio is meant.
Beta: Messages All / Unread count conversations, not every message.

Beta: map filter with how far (internet 20/50/100 km, radio 20/50/100 km or no limit) and a count of stations on the map; what is new after an update; the tracker offer at most once an hour with Not today; lists open on their last line at once; framed bars at the bottom; the handheld radio icon wherever the radio is meant.
On a phone the app comes back on the screen that was open after Android restarted it in the background.
Tune a VGC VR-N76 / BTECH UV-PRO / Radioddity GA-5WB from the app over its KISS TNC; QRZ.com in station details; the profile's symbol in the top bar; menus stay open after a choice.

Messages: coloured circles with unread counts, All/Unread filter and search, Mark all as read, unread kept across updates; radio and internet as two remembered icons; the unread total in notifications; APRS Thursday relays on its own screen; clearer menus and dialogs in every language; the offline map light in the dark mode; a log with Copy log and steadier restarts on phones.

Beta: All/Unread filter and search in Messages; APRS Thursday in Messages › Services and its relays no longer in Messages; a walkie-talkie icon; the offline map light in the dark mode; menus fit in every language.
Beta: radio and internet as two remembered icons in Messages; the new-message form shows at once; menu boxes that keep the menu open; framed dialogs; a log with Copy log in About.
Beta: the station list says why it is empty (filter, or only internet stations hidden); the TAK explanation is shown whole.

Beta: coloured circles with a letter in Messages and an unread count on each; the total of unread messages in notifications; a menu with Mark all as read; unread messages stay unread after a restart or an update.

Notifications of new messages and chat lines (Android in the background; Linux, Windows and macOS when the window is not in front); in Messages back goes to the list first, a round + for a new message, unread conversations marked, the REPEAT service works, accented letters read right; each profile with its own comment and tracker way; clearer menus and serial errors.

Beta: notifications of new messages and chat lines (Android in the background, Linux, Windows, macOS when the window is not in front); back from a conversation goes to the list first; a round + for a new message; the REPEAT service works; accented letters read right; a garbled reject is not shown as a message.
Beta: each profile has its own position comment and tracker way (fixed interval or SmartBeaconing); the active profile is marked; menus stand out with a frame and a shadow.
Beta: unread messages stay counted while Messages is open; a red dot marks unread conversations; plain-words serial TNC errors.

A TNC over Bluetooth LE (a LoRa APRS tracker, Mobilinkd TNC4, PicoAPRS …); spotting a SOTA, POTA, WWFF, GMA and other activation by radio; services on APRS (FIND, REPEAT, WXNOW, UTC, satellite passes, e-mail) in Messages; Android: a radio plugged in opens the app, and smaller fixes.
Beta: a TNC over Bluetooth LE (KISS over BLE), such as a LoRa APRS tracker, Mobilinkd TNC4 or PicoAPRS.
Beta: self-spotting an activation (SOTA, POTA, WWFF, GMA and more) and services on APRS (FIND, REPEAT, WXNOW, UTC, satellites, e-mail) in Messages; Android fixes.
Beta: on Android, a radio plugged in offers to open the app.
The first stable version. Testers can get beta versions too (Settings › App).
Send your position or any place from the map (coordinates or locator) to the chat or in a message; positions in messages and chat open on the map.

New Files section: files over packet radio (YAPP) with progress, resume and a time estimate. Messages: several parts numbered 1/2, 2/2; distance and a map button in a conversation; deleting a conversation; long messages wrap.
Weather stations show their temperature on the map; the phone offers to switch the tracker on when you seem to be driving.
Text centred in the phone's small TNC and IS lamps.
Computer top bar with the same lamps as on a phone (TNC, IS, GPS, position, TX); the back-to-me button moved above the scale.
The whole callsign fits in the phone's top bar again; one-line map filter menu; TNC errors translated.
Station profiles: up to three SSIDs with their own symbol, switched by tapping the callsign; map lines start in the middle of the symbol.

Map filters (weather, moving, repeaters, road incidents); repeaters show their frequency and band; the map follows you while the tracker runs, with a back-to-me countdown; optional warnings of road incidents and moving stations ahead.
One switch to send position and messages over the internet too; the IS lamp flashes red on sending; stations sharing a place spread around a visible dot.
The .flatpak file installs again (signed); settings fields aligned to the left in a wide window.
The map is always redrawn after zooming with the fingers.
Your own trail; APRS objects as their own places; fixes for stray lines and lost markers on the map.
Measure distances on the map; station symbols on a light disc; a dot where a moved marker's station is.
Android back gesture goes back through the screens; Settings ask about unsaved changes; nicer station labels; markers no longer jump when zooming.
APRS-IS keeps working after the settings are saved; overlapping station markers are spread out; a tidier map menu.
A tracker with SmartBeaconing; APRS-IS can be switched on again (the licence sentence showed no field); no false "no internet" after the background.
Import your own offline maps (MBTiles, PMTiles, SQLiteDB, ZIP/7z); station trails; a foldable map toolbar.
APRS-IS stations around the phone's GPS position; a tidier phone top bar.
APRS digipeater (fill-in or full); on Android a TNC over Bluetooth.
Offline map with motorways, main roads, smaller places and more peaks.
Android: keeps running in the background with a notification. Keep the screen on: never, while TAK runs, or always.
Required callsign, an offline map with towns and peaks, a scale bar, a map that turns less easily, a TX lamp that lights up while on air.
Confirmation sentences asked only once; the phone's GPS by default and its position shown in Settings; a handheld radio symbol.
The phone's language is recognised and asked for at the first start; settings folded up in blocks; sounds for transmitting and new messages.
TAK: a slim header, map and GeoChat as two screens on phones, the team's moves shown in GeoChat.
Phone top bar as a dashboard (TNC, GPS, TX lamps), the same on/off icons on every screen, a simpler terminal.
A warning at the first start: transmitting needs an amateur radio licence. Preparations for Google Play.
The new-version check works on phones too; on Android the new package is downloaded straight away. About is in the phone's menu.
Map: small zoom buttons and a compass that turns the map north up. Android: the app icon is blue to the edges, without a white margin.
On phones the screens are in a menu sliding in from the side (the menu button) instead of a bar along the bottom.
A much faster map, above all on phones: only the area on screen is sent, unchanged stations are not sent again, and switching screens keeps the map.
The phone's own GPS as your position. Map filters as icons, a smaller map credit, instant switching between the offline and the online map.
Android: a TNC on the phone's USB port. Phone layout fixes and callsigns always in capitals.
On phones the screens are in a bar along the bottom instead of a side menu.
Builds for Android, macOS and iOS, a layout for phones, and fast switching of TAK and BBS SERVER.
TAK frames are no longer mistaken for APRS stations outside TAK mode.
The terminal can connect over VARA FM as well as over AX.25 packet.
An offline map with country borders and bigger cities, used by itself when there is no internet.
Your position from a USB GPS module, and a TAK mode: ATAK-compatible positions and GeoChat over the radio.
Chat messages starting with an APRS character (such as a smiley) and long messages now reach other stations.
A guide to the BBS SERVER in English and Czech, a Czech README and new screenshots.
BBS SERVER: run your own packet BBS, configured in files and in Settings. The terminal shows connect attempts and can stop them.
A section for the weekly #APRSThursday net (check in, the group's messages, when the next net starts) and a list of saved BBSes in the terminal.
Station labels on the map have a dark frame, and a button mutes the map's colours so the stations stand out.
Polish translation. The chat no longer shows automatic frames such as digipeater DX reports.
Stations and messages that an iGate relays from the internet by radio are now shown: the station on the map, the message in your inbox, acknowledged by radio.
The monitor can hide stations from the internet (APRS-IS) and show only radio traffic. Windows installer.
Thirteen more languages: Danish, German, Spanish, French, Croatian, Italian, Norwegian, Brazilian Portuguese, Slovak, Slovenian, Serbian, Swedish and Ukrainian.
Choose light, dark or the system's appearance; better detection of a dark desktop.
Own Flatpak repository with automatic updates. Right-click the map to set your position. More compact settings.
Tells you when a new version is out (checked at most once a day; can be switched off).
Closing the window asks first, so receiving and the beacon are not stopped by accident.
A legend for the map and the station list, names for all APRS symbols, and a choice to show stations seen only on the internet.
Packaged for installing from a software centre: Flatpak and Debian packages, an app icon. An About window with links to the source, the F4HWN firmware and the author.
First standalone version: map, APRS messages, stations, packet terminal, chat, monitor and APRS-IS.
